title: The Machinery Of Freedom: Illustrated summary
summary: An illustrated 23-minute summary of David Friedman's talk based on The Machinery of Freedom. It describes how law, police and courts could work as market services in a stateless society, covering private law, polycentric law and objections.
why: HN commenters use it as a short introduction to anarcho-capitalist ideas about private law and how disputes could be resolved without a state.

quote.text: it's an illustrated talk by David D. Friedman, explaining how police, courts and other things would exist and work in a world without government
